title: slopvac v3 pack index
description: The pack index document that `slopvac packs search` reads. A scheduled job rebuilds it from packs that follow the naming convention. The index lists packs for discovery and nothing more: it is not an authority for keys, and `publisher_key` is display-only (threat-model.md, section 5.2). A reader refuses a document over 32 MiB before it parses. Unknown keys are errors, and keys that start with `x-` are ignored. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/pack-index.md. Owner: slopvac-8l4.9.8.

packs.description: One entry per pack, sorted by namespace and then id, with no pair repeated. At most 100000 entries.

PackIndexSemver.description: Semantic version 2.0.0 without build metadata. Major, minor and patch have at most nine digits (at most 999999999), which is the bound the reader enforces. Otherwise the pattern is the Semver def of pack-manifest.schema.json, repeated here until that schema is on main.

PackIndexSource.description: Where to fetch the pack: an oci:// reference, an https:// release archive URL, or a git+https:// URL pinned to a full commit hash after @. The URL carries no user-info. http:// and path sources are invalid: a public listing has no project root.

PublisherKey.description: The key the publisher signs with, for display. Never a trust anchor: a first install shows the fingerprint and waits for the explicit pinning command, and a pinned key wins over this value.

key_id.description: Minisign key id, 16 uppercase hex digits.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the raw public key bytes, 64 lowercase hex digits. This is the value that `slopvac plugins trust --key` takes.

id.description: Pack id from the pack manifest.

namespace.description: Publisher namespace that the key and the source are bound to. Same character set as a pack id.

name.description: Display name. Text from the index: a reader escapes control characters before it prints.

description.description: One-line summary. Text from the index: a reader escapes control characters before it prints.

slopvac_api.description: Lowest pack and plugin extension API the host must implement. A host with a lower API cannot load the pack. At most 4294967295, the bound the reader enforces. A whole number written with a fraction, such as 2.0, is an integer here and in the reader.
